reviewSummary: ACCEPT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The subject and payload remain at the dispatched mode-0444 bytes; live HEAD, COORD, file 08, required-now, and every permitted cited digest agree with the candidate. The payload is exactly the four-byte prefix 00010000, N=65536, with no body, and is byte-identical to the two frozen comparison payloads. Unlike v34, v35 authors only the prefix integer, expressly records that the receiver must read the body and that zero body bytes are fewer than N, does not deny the recorded truncated-body predicate, does not claim a complete frame or delivery of 65536 body bytes, and leaves the observable refusal route unpinned. The v34 Claude MUST-FIX and SHOULD-FIX and the unlabeled Codex MUST-FIX therefore land without inventing an identifier. The candidate binds NOTHING, retains OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING, closes no leftover-design, preserves leftover-join.v45 of G21 as the D-359 current remasurement, keeps the postHandshake exact-bound half unauthored, and satisfies no protected row.
